summary: Codere Online Luxembourg, S.A. (Nasdaq: CDRO / CDROW), a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the filing of its annual report on Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. No transaction, corporate action, or special situation is disclosed; the filing is a routine annual report notification to the SEC and shareholders. The press release provides instructions for accessing the report digitally or requesting a free hard copy. There are no deal terms, structural changes, or strategic review. This is a standard regulatory compliance filing with no special-situation event.
